# uptimecheck_projects (Data Source)

The workspace's projects (often one per client).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimecheck_projects" "all" {}

locals {
  acme_project_id = one([for p in data.uptimecheck_projects.all.items : p.id if p.name == "Acme"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) Every entry in the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

- `name` (String) Unique in the workspace.
